hooks.command: sh -c 'cache_base="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache/agents-cowork-with-jira/jira-sync"; version="$(find "$cache_base" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n 1 | xargs basename 2>/dev/null)"; root="$cache_base/$version"; if [ -n "$version" ] && [ -f "$root/bin/codex-sessionstart-launcher.mjs" ]; then exec node "$root/bin/codex-sessionstart-launcher.mjs"; fi; echo "jira-sync hook: could not resolve Codex SessionStart launcher" >&2; exit 0'
